_comment: まんが「連絡した つもり？」の 16ページ（content/manga/renraku_manga.json・size:"page"・speechInImage:true）。2026-09-25 の 指定「一般的なカラー漫画の形式」「全ての漢字には正確なふりがな」「吹き出しの文字は横」。焼く 字は セリフと 一字一句 同じ（教材データの bakedText）。ふりがなは 教材の 読み辞書から bakedReadings（src/lib/manga-baked.ts）で 出した もの。noText の 前半は RUBY_LETTERING（src/lib/manga-prompt.ts）の 逐語。参照は ソカ・奥田・ヘンディの 設定画＋1枚目（p01）が 絵柄アンカー。コマは 全幅の 横帯を 上から 下へ 重ねる（横書きなので 読む 順が 迷わない）。
style: A full-colour Japanese manga PAGE for a language-learning lesson — one portrait page, drawn like a modern colour manga / webtoon: clean confident black linework, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette of sky blue, cream and coral, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows. A tidy contemporary software office in Japan with real desks, chairs, windows, plants and laptops. The page is divided into full-width horizontal panels stacked from top to bottom, separated by white gutters, each panel with a thin black border. A small rounded white box at the very top-left corner of the page shows the time label. People are real human beings with natural proportions, warm friendly faces and exactly five fingers on each hand. Keep every character's face, hair and outfit exactly as in the reference model sheets (Soka: coral shirt, long straight black hair; Okuda: black rectangular glasses, dark green hoodie; Hendy: navy suit and navy necktie). Speech balloons are white, rounded, with a tail pointing at the speaker and never covering a face. Thought bubbles are cloud-shaped with small trailing circles. Chat app screens are drawn big and simple: white message boxes with a small round avatar, text large and bold. Everything on screens that is not listed text is blank or plain grey bars.
noText: Lettering — read this part carefully. All lettering is HORIZONTAL (left to right, yokogaki) — never vertical. Copy every text EXACTLY as given, character for character: do not translate, rephrase, shorten, or add anything. Directly above EVERY kanji, print its reading in small hiragana (furigana), centred over that kanji, clearly separated from it, at about 45% of the kanji height. Use exactly the readings listed below — never guess a reading. Hiragana, katakana, Latin letters, digits and symbols take no furigana. Letter it large and clearly legible in a plain rounded manga font. The picture contains ONLY the texts listed for this page and the time label, and no other writing at all: no extra words, no names on shirts, no logos, no watermarks, no signatures, no page numbers, no sound effects other than those listed.
negative: Never: channel names, sidebar labels, button labels, page titles or screen headings written in kanji that are not in the list (leave them as grey bars), extra spaces inside a word, invented chat messages or any Japanese sentence that is not in the list for this page, vertical text, missing furigana over any kanji, furigana over hiragana or katakana, a reading different from the list, misspelled or invented characters, extra words, English translations, photo-realistic rendering, harsh shadows, extra or merged fingers, distorted hands, dark or scary mood, angry or crying faces, real company logos, national flags, tiny unreadable text, panels read right-to-left.
